start:
usage: anchorium_cli.py start [-h] [--authorized] [--state STATE]
                              [--venue {par,pas}]
                              [--readiness-release READINESS_RELEASE]
                              [--readiness-native-proof READINESS_NATIVE_PROOF]
                              [--markets [MARKETS ...]]
                              [--scan-seconds SCAN_SECONDS]
                              [--duration DURATION] [--mandate MANDATE]
                              [--acceptance ACCEPTANCE] [--release RELEASE]
                              [--native-protection-evidence NATIVE_PROTECTION_EVIDENCE]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --authorized
  --state STATE
  --venue {par,pas}     Explicit isolated practice or scored profile; grants
                        no signing authority
  --readiness-release READINESS_RELEASE
                        Public verification only; grants no authority
  --readiness-native-proof READINESS_NATIVE_PROOF
                        Public raw-proof verification only; grants no
                        authority
  --markets [MARKETS ...]
  --scan-seconds SCAN_SECONDS
  --duration DURATION   Optional bounded read-only development soak; signing
                        expiry is unchanged
  --mandate MANDATE
  --acceptance ACCEPTANCE
  --release RELEASE
  --native-protection-evidence NATIVE_PROTECTION_EVIDENCE
prepare:
usage: anchorium_cli.py prepare [-h] --output OUTPUT [--markets [MARKETS ...]]
                                [--venue {par,pas}]
                                [--organizer-confirmation ORGANIZER_CONFIRMATION]
                                [--minutes MINUTES]
                                [--maximum-notional MAXIMUM_NOTIONAL]
                                [--release RELEASE]
                                [--native-protection-evidence NATIVE_PROTECTION_EVIDENCE]
                                [--overnight | --practice-weekend]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --output OUTPUT
  --markets [MARKETS ...]
  --venue {par,pas}
  --organizer-confirmation ORGANIZER_CONFIRMATION
                        Reviewed organizer provenance JSON with retained
                        original record; PAS only
  --minutes MINUTES
  --maximum-notional MAXIMUM_NOTIONAL
  --release RELEASE
  --native-protection-evidence NATIVE_PROTECTION_EVIDENCE
  --overnight           Propose Oct 16–17 bounded scope, hard expiry Oct 17
                        noon IST; no automatic approval
  --practice-weekend    Propose Oct17–18 scope, <=24h and no later than Oct18
                        23:57 IST; native proof and fresh exact approval
                        required
